review_type: Unblinded subjective AI review; not ground truth or statistical certification

rubric.unit: Each fixed prefix and its up-to-48-token continuation.

dimensions.relevance: 0 unrelated or incoherent; 1 partly relevant with drift; 2 follows the prefix throughout.
dimensions.local_consistency: 0 contradicts prefix or itself; 1 ambiguous or minor inconsistency; 2 consistent with supplied facts and own continuation.
dimensions.language: 0 mostly unreadable; 1 understandable with substantial grammatical defects; 2 readable connected language.
dimensions.repetition: 0 stuck in repeated phrase or loop; 1 distracting redundancy; 2 no distracting repetition.

rubric.report: Report all dimension counts and means, loop rate, empty outputs and raw completions. A token-cap truncation alone is not a coherence failure. This is an informative base-completion rubric, without an absolute chat-readiness gate. Freeze rubric and disclose evaluator identity before outputs are judged.

interpretation_notes: Scores assess prefix plus entire continuation, not an isolated fluent fragment.
Local consistency=1 means indeterminate/nonsensical or ambiguous, not demonstrated consistency; 0 requires an explicit contradiction.
Language=1 includes parseable but disconnected repetitive clauses, consistent with the earlier reviewer interpretation; 2 requires readable connected language throughout.
Loop flags are manual judgments of distracting recurring phrases, not a statistical detector.
Token-cap truncation itself is not penalized; terminal partial bytes/words alone are not evidence of data corruption.
No outside factual verification. All 64 paired completions reviewed; checkpoint labels known. Cross-reviewer scores at earlier checkpoints are not directly comparable.
